title: querylog.py digest counts an empty tests.py selection (exit 2, selected 0) as failed, not as selected nothing
goal: ql_report.ops_lines counts a test.run row with exit 2 and selected 0 (tests.py's refusal of a selection that collects nothing, ST-pvtfs43r) under selected nothing and not under failed, beside the exit 5 rows of older weeks, so the digest's selected nothing count stays the signal of wasted empty runs.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import ql_report; sys.exit(0 if ql_report.NOTHING_SELECTED == 2 else 1)
